characterization_methods.key_findings: 550 °C aging for 3 h gives 790.3 ± 23.5 HV (15Al alloy); this is the hardness of the present sample.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: load 9.8 N, dwell 15 s; each sample tested 5 times with values averaged
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure hardness of the 15Al alloy after solution treatment and after the various aging treatments

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: ZEISS Sigma 300 SEM operated at 5 kV
characterization_methods.key_findings: Fig. 7 (figure_007) presents SE images of the 15Al alloy after different aging treatments, including the 550 °C row (1, 3, 6, 10 h); α-Mn precipitates as fine particles dispersed in the α matrix and β-Mn precipitates as short rods along α grain boundaries and within α grains.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: electrolytically polished samples (10 % perchloric acid + 90 % ethanol)
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify precipitation of secondary phases (α-Mn and β-Mn) in the aged 15Al samples

characterization_methods.key_findings: The density of the 15Al alloy is 6.85 g·cm⁻³.
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure the density of the Fe-Mn-Al-Cu low-density alloys

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Raw materials of high purity (>99.9 %) melted in a vacuum induction furnace under an argon atmosphere to produce Fe-35Mn-15Al-5Cu (at.%) ingots (the 15Al alloy).
Hot-rolled into plates with a thickness of 4 mm.
Plates cut into 10 × 5 × 2 mm³ samples; solution treated at 1100 °C for 10 min under argon, then oil quenched. This is the parent/precursor state (parent_process_id proc_st-1100c-10min-oq).
Solution-treated 15Al samples aged at 550 °C for 3 h, followed by water quenching. This is the defining step of the sample.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Vickers microhardness: load 9.8 N, dwell 15 s; each sample measured 5 times and averaged
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: 10 × 5 × 2 mm³ (electrical-discharge-machined samples for Vickers hardness measurements)

phases_present.grain_size: coarse grains (tens to hundreds of µm; a few very large grains)

structures.overall_structure: In the solution-treated condition (1100 °C/10 min + oil quench, the precursor state of this sample) the 15Al alloy consists of a single α (body-centered cubic, BCC) phase; no γ (FCC) is resolved.

phases_present.morphology: short rod-shaped precipitates along α grain boundaries and within the interior of α grains

structures.overall_structure: After aging at 550 °C for 3 h the 15Al alloy is partially transformed: β-Mn precipitates from the α (BCC) matrix. Vickers hardness reaches 790.3 ± 23.5 HV, intermediate between the 1 h value (380.2 HV) and the 6 h value (957.1 HV) at the same 550 °C, indicating incomplete α→β-Mn transformation at this stage. No EBSD map was acquired for the exact 550 °C/3 h condition.

unmapped_findings: Among the 15Al alloy aging series, the 550 °C curve shows the slowest hardening response: hardness is only ~380 HV after 1 h and ~790 HV after 3 h (this sample), and reaches the peak (957.1 ± 15.5 HV) only after 6 h, whereas at 575 °C and above the hardening is substantially accelerated.
